Luke, I learned this trade from my family, and I want our village to keep earning from it for years. Taking 15 each gains us $5,000 now but cuts next month’s sustainable share to just 5 each. That’s a poor bargain if we can agree on restraint.

I propose 10 pallets each this month, with everyone’s production reviewed afterward. If anyone exceeds that, let’s negotiate compensating reductions rather than start a race that ruins the river. I’m prepared to choose 10 and honor that agreement. John, will you join me—and Luke, will you reconsider if the rest of us commit?
